entries.0872761685636ca7: Headquartered in Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo, the company and its 8 consolidated subsidiaries form the group. Its core business is industrial cutting tools. It manufactures and sells cutting tools, including drills for printed circuit boards (PCB tools) and carbide end mills, as well as other products such as thread-rolling dies, in four regions: Japan, Asia, North America and Europe. Consolidated number of employees in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was 1,530.
